name: NY-07
label: Safe D

key_factors: Valdez's strong fundraising and outside support
Republican nominee with no reported fundraising
model.rationale: The D+25 fundamentals make this a heavily Democratic seat, and Valdez has raised over $1.6 million with outside backing while Rivera shows no reported fundraising. Markets price a Democratic win at 97%, consistent with a Safe D rating.
model.watch: A late surge in Republican outside spending or an unexpectedly competitive independent candidacy could narrow the margin.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: Nydia Velázquez (D) is not on the ballot.

overview:
Nydia Velázquez's retirement leaves this Brooklyn-Queens seat open, but the district's D+25 partisan lean keeps it firmly in Democratic hands. Claire Valdez enters the general with strong financial backing, having raised over $1.6 million and drawn more than $1.2 million in outside support, while Republican Melvin Rivera reports no fundraising activity.

Prediction markets price a Democratic win at roughly 97%, and no expert raters flag the race as competitive. With no public polling available, the forecast rests on district fundamentals and the lopsided financial picture, both of which point to a comfortable Democratic hold.
